notes.8.103: ḥmwt-rʾ, literally 'craft of the mouth', is spell-work or sorcery; 'by people [or] sorcery' might also be 'by sorcerous people'.
notes.8.96: ꜣḫt (plural) taken as 'spells' or spirit-powers; it may stand for jḫt 'thing', as in the formula 'every evil and bad thing'. j:ḏd=st could also be 'that she has spoken'.

nodes.text: because, as for your neck, it is the vertebrae(?) of the backbone of Nehebkau.
I have rescued you, I have protected you from every evil and bad spell(?), from every magic that has been spoken against you.
As for your hind-part, it is the hind-part of Isis.
Your hind-part shall not be overpowered by people [or] sorcery.
No magic that male and female magicians make shall enter against you.
What they have done shall not come to pass;
what they say shall not be heard.
Their magic is cut off and turned back to their mouths by Ra himself.
N, born of N, is purified as Ra is pure every day.
